title: Nice Shears
text: Nice Shears. These are nice shears but a little on the heavy side. The grip is also two wide for little hands. It does come apart for easy cleaning and snaps together for safety when not in use.

product_metadata.title: Chef'sChoice Kitchen Shears (Discontinued by Manufacturer)
description: These ultrasharp kitchen shears are designed for just about anything in the kitchen, from cutting sprigs of herbs and the strings off a roast to heavier-duty tasks such as cutting thin meats. Fully forged from an ultrahigh-carbon stainless metal alloy called Trizor steel, the blades have a higher carbon content than other kitchen knives and shears, giving them a higher tensile strength, which makes them stronger and more resilient. The ultrasharp blades come out of the box 2 to 3 times sharper and last up to 10 times longer than those of other brands, but can be sharpened with conventional sharpeners. Molded-on handles are safe in the dishwasher, but hand washing is recommended to keep steel blades scratch free.
